review_method.viewport_method: Browser layout audit of all 8 formal-source pages at 375, 768, and 1440 CSS pixels, plus static accessibility and responsive checks
review_method.browser_visual_check: All 24 route-width combinations matched the intended canonical URL and had scrollWidth equal to clientWidth. The final gamepasses page was also visually inspected at 375px after factual corrections.

evidence: Every page reported clientWidth=375 and scrollWidth=375.
Single-column layouts, full-width calls to action, collapsed navigation, tables, and long catalog IDs remained usable.
The homepage primary button is 62px tall and links to /beginner-guide/; the secondary button is 50px tall.
Every page reported clientWidth=768 and scrollWidth=768.
Tablet card grids and page heroes rendered without overlap or horizontal overflow.
The beginner-guide contents panel correctly switches out of sticky desktop behavior.
Every page reported clientWidth=1440 and scrollWidth=1440.
The homepage kept its bounded two-column hero and multi-column content grids.
Navigation, calls to action, tables, cards, and the sticky guide contents rendered without overlap.

checks: Labeled mobile menu and checklist controls
Scrollable table wrappers at narrow widths

navigation_checks.notes: src/lint.mjs verifies every internal route and fragment, one canonical per page, and exact sitemap-to-route parity.

fact_reference_checks.notes: Codex removed content derived from rejected facts 073 and 074, plus unapproved assertions about matching chickens, code timing and failure causes, gamepass behavior and value, broad Robux Skip resets, and cross-rarity earnings comparisons.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The Kimi design package run_id differed from the approved research run_id.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Only design.run_id was changed to chicken-farm-20260820-043000, after which validate_handoffs passed.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The candidate included rejected or expanded factual claims across rebirth, updates, beginner, codes, gamepasses, and merge content.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex rewrote those passages to the exact approved fact set and added lint guards for the rejected wording.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The candidate HTTP test used a fixed port and asserted one raw headline substring.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Codex made the test reserve an available local port and assert the stable internal beginner-guide entry instead of span-sensitive headline text.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The candidate directory also contained old acceptance packages, v1/v2 packages, Playwright artifacts, screenshots, and cross-site logs.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: None of those files were integrated; only the v3 public pages, stylesheet, sitemap, and corrected test modules were accepted.
